description: The reference of ep05_td_dead_section: an EU07, whose pantographs come first and whose line breaker opens without voltage (no PantRequiresMain), runs into the same span without voltage under power. Its line breaker opens 0.2 s into the section (the log says it lost power for 0.2x s, no longer: it says so only while the line breaker is closed), and behind it the AI closes the line breaker again, takes power and stops at Przystanek.
